model.fintech.payment_risk.name: payment_risk
model.fintech.payment_risk.compiled_code: select payment_id, merchant_id, amount from raw.payments where created_at >= dateadd(day, -7, current_date)

model.fintech.risk_dashboard.name: risk_dashboard
model.fintech.risk_dashboard.compiled_code: select merchant_id, sum(amount) as amount from analytics.payment_risk group by 1
